New tile

Source: R/class_Tile.R
new_tile.Rd

Create a new tile object to store information for rendering a layer from a PMTiles archive file.

Usage

new_tile(source_layer, path, max_zoom)

Arguments

source_layer

character value with name of layer source in the archive file.

path

character value with file path for the archive file. Note that file must have a ".pmtiles" file extension.

max_zoom

integer maximum zoom level for the archive.

Value

A Tile object.

See also

Other functions for defining classes: Dataset, Project, new_categorical_legend(), new_continuous_legend(), new_cost(), new_feature(), new_layer(), new_lock(), new_project(), new_provenance(), new_solution(), new_solution_legend(), new_theme()

Examples

# create dummy file
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".pmtiles")
writeLines("dummy", path)

# create object
x <- new_tile(source = "data-src", path = path, max_zoom = 5)

# print object
print(x)
#> A <Tile> object.
